title: Create per-model prompt formatter module chatbot/core/prompt_formatter.py
description:
Create the per-model prompt formatter module `chatbot/core/prompt_formatter.py`.

This module must select the appropriate formatting strategy based on the model family (e.g., Anthropic Claude system instructions vs OpenAI system messages vs Gemini system instruction blocks). It must handle unknown model families by gracefully falling back to a standard format/default behavior.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- chatbot/core/ for model and prompt format styles

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed paths. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed files modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/core/prompt_formatter.py exists and is a valid Python module
Prompt formatting supports Anthropic/OpenAI/Gemini formatting paradigms
Formatting gracefully falls back to default layout for unknown models
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: change the Abracapocus runtime, orchestrator, or backends

allowed: define formatter registry or enum mappings
forbidden: introduce dependencies on external API clients
